description: What a failure knows beyond its code and message.

action.description:
How far an action's input got when it failed: not delivered, delivered
with a later wait failing, or lost with the connection after delivery
began.

url.description: The tab's URL when the action failed.

condition.description: The element condition that was not met.

interceptor.description: What intercepted the pointer instead of the target.

count.description: How many elements an ambiguous target matched.

delivered.description: How many characters `type` delivered before it failed.

debuggingCallers.description:
The numbers of the agents whose debugging connections hold the tab
when a command on it times out.

title: ErrorDetails
